title: Simeon's Prayer: Now You Are Releasing Your Servant in Peace (Luke 2)
text: An old man named Simeon had waited his whole life. It had been revealed to him that he would not die before he saw the Lord's Christ. One day, in the temple courts, a young couple from Galilee walked in with a baby. Simeon took the child in his arms, and said this. Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace; for my eyes have seen your salvation, which you have prepared before the face of all peoples; a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.
